system.notes: A hypersense that lets the magician talk mind to mind (words, emotions, images) with one person chosen when the spell was designed (Restricted Target: that individual). The subject must be in line of sight and range when it's cast, then may leave line of sight but must stay in range. One success at TN 4 makes the link; an unwilling subject resists with Willpower against the spell's Force, reducing the caster's successes. A failed link means recasting, with Drain. Grimoire (2nd ed.) p.128.
